value.rationale: This is a complete classification for all sixteen forbidden four-bit factors, modulo their six natural symmetries, at twelve consecutive window orders, not a routine single-instance extension. It yields 72 exact single-circle benchmarks with tight combinatorial certificates and exposes a nontrivial change in the ordering of six constrained-language cover lengths. The precise invariants matter for constrained universal sequencing and testing general shortest-superstring methods.
